title: Abstract Newton-Polytope Obstruction
content: not_sos_of_neg_diag: a bivariate real polynomial of total degree ≤ 6 whose six pure-power coefficients (x⁶, x⁴, x², y⁶, y⁴, y²) vanish and whose x²y² coefficient is negative cannot be a sum of squares. In any representation P = ∑ qᵢ², the degree bound forces each qᵢ to have degree ≤ 3, the pure-power vanishing kills all pure powers of each qᵢ, and the only surviving contribution to x²y² is ([xy]qᵢ)², so [x²y²]P = ∑ ([xy]qᵢ)² ≥ 0 — contradicting negativity.
prerequisites: Newton polytope of a sum of squares

title: Coefficients of the Motzkin Family
content: motzkinPoly c = x⁴y² + x²y⁴ + 1 − c·x²y² (imported from sibling oq-05) is rewritten in monomial form; its six pure-power coefficients vanish, its x²y² coefficient is −c, and its total degree is ≤ 6 — exactly the hypotheses needed to feed the abstract obstruction.

title: Explicit SOS Decomposition for c ≤ 0
content: For c ≤ 0 the deficit term −c·x²y² is itself a square, giving the literal sum of squares Mₐ = (x²y)² + (xy²)² + (√(−c)·xy)² + 1². The witness uses Real.sqrt(−c), valid since −c ≥ 0.

title: Sharp SOS Threshold
content: motzkinPoly_sos_iff: Mₐ is a sum of squares of polynomials if and only if c ≤ 0. The SOS cone closes at c = 0, strictly inside the PSD cone (which closes at c = 3).

title: The Gap Is Exactly (0,3]
content: motzkinPoly_psd_not_sos_iff: a family member is PSD but not SOS iff 0 < c ≤ 3. Combining the sharp PSD threshold (c ≤ 3, oq-05) and the sharp SOS threshold (c ≤ 0) shows the PSD ⊋ SOS gap is the whole half-open interval (0,3] — the Motzkin point c = 3 is not isolated.
